summary: Completed comprehensive testing of P1: User Pinning + Pin Boards feature. All 20 backend API tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified - Pins home page, Create Board modal, PinButton on Frame detail modal, and ListingDetailPage integration all working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Test pins and boards created and cleaned up via API tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: User Pinning + Pin Boards feature (P1) is complete and fully functional. Default 'Saved' board auto-creates on first access. PinButton component integrated into Frame detail modal and ListingDetailPage. Owner cannot pin/message their own listing (correct behavior). All board CRUD, pin CRUD, move, and check status operations working.
